# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Since Scattering Core is actively developed, security updates are generally applied only to the latest major release.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- |-----------|
| Latest  | yes       |
| < 1.0   | no        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Scattering Core, please report it responsibly. **Do not disclose it publicly** via public GitHub issues, pull requests, or social media until it has been addressed.

Instead, please report it via one of the following methods:

* **Email:** Send an email directly to your primary maintainer email address.
* **GitHub Security Advisories:** You can use the private vulnerability reporting feature on the [Security tab of this repository](https://github.com/light-scattering/scattering.core/security/advisories/new).

Please include as much detail as possible to help reproduce and fix the issue, such as:
* The version of the core library, CLI, or wrappers affected.
* A description of the vulnerability and potential impact.
* Step-by-step instructions or a minimal reproducible example, if applicable.

You can expect an acknowledgment of your report within a reasonable timeframe, followed by updates as the issue is investigated and patched.
